trainingdummy.configuration.title: Training Dummy - Client Config
trainingdummy.configuration.hitResetSeco: Every hit adds to a running total. If this many seconds pass without a hit, the next hit starts a fresh total instead of adding to the old one.
trainingdummy.configuration.displayDurat: How long the damage readout stays visible after the last hit.
trainingdummy.configuration.displayLocat: Where to show the damage readout: on screen (HUD) or in your own chat.
trainingdummy.configuration.baitRadius.t: How far mobs are pulled from to attack a dummy holding the lure bait.
trainingdummy.configuration.maxHealth.to: The dummy's max health. It's kept topped off every tick regardless of this value, so even 1 never actually lets a hit kill it - hitting it with a Stick is still the only way to remove one.
trainingdummy.configuration.displayOffse: Horizontal pixel offset from the center of the screen (negative = left, positive = right). SCREEN readout only.
Vertical pixel offset up from the bottom of the screen. SCREEN readout only.
trainingdummy.configuration.displayColor: Text color as a 6-digit RRGGBB or 8-digit AARRGGBB hex string, no # prefix. SCREEN readout only.
trainingdummy.display.total.name: Total
trainingdummy.display.dps.name: DPS
trainingdummy.display.perhit.name: Per Hit
trainingdummy.combat.damageCapped: Damage capped at the float limit

gui.trainingdummy.title: Biggest Hit Leaderboard
gui.trainingdummy.empty: No records yet - be the first!
trainingdummy.record.local: New local record! You're now #%s on this server's leaderboard.
trainingdummy.record.achieved: New record! You're now #%s on the leaderboard (pending confirmation).
trainingdummy.record.confirmed: Record confirmed! Sending to the server... You're #%s on the leaderboard.
trainingdummy.record.rejected: The leaderboard updated in the meantime and your record didn't make the cut :(
trainingdummy.record.communication_error: Couldn't confirm your record - there was a problem communicating with the leaderboard server. Please try again later.
trainingdummy.configuration.modpackId.to: Identifies this server's modpack to the leaderboard worker. Every server sharing a leaderboard must use the same value. Leave blank to use the mod's built-in default shared leaderboard.
trainingdummy.configuration.modpackDispl: Friendly name shown in the global leaderboard's title (e.g. "ATM 11"). Purely cosmetic - leave blank to just show a generic title.
trainingdummy.configuration.leaderboardR: Minimum time between this server re-checking the worker for leaderboard updates.
trainingdummy.configuration.recordDeboun: How long to wait after a qualifying hit before submitting it, in case the same player beats it again shortly after.
trainingdummy.configuration.workerBaseUr: Base URL of the leaderboard worker (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8787 for a local wrangler dev you're running yourself). Leave blank to use the mod's built-in worker.
trainingdummy.configuration.workerApiKey: Sent as the X-Api-Key header on every submission, if set. Must match modpackId's own key on the worker. Leave blank to use the mod's built-in default modpack's key.
trainingdummy.configuration.globalLeader: Turns the cross-server global leaderboard on or off entirely. Off disables fetching, showing and submitting to it; the local leaderboard keeps working either way. On by default.
trainingdummy.configuration.weaponBlackl: Extra item IDs banned from scoring, ADDED ON TOP of the mod's built-in blacklist (can't remove or override it). Exact IDs ("minecraft:netherite_sword"), a whole mod with "modid:*" ("avaritia:*"), or - with no ":" - a substring match against every item ID ("sword").
